top_signals.title: As Sanofi's Pompe drug shortage drags on, some patients struggle to access treatments
top_signals.summary: An ongoing shortage of Sanofi’s Pompe disease treatment is forcing some patients to miss critical doses. They worry their health is at risk.

top_signals.title: Central Asia Faces a Looming Water Crisis as Glaciers Retreat
top_signals.summary: An Asian Development Bank analysis of four decades of weather patterns raises an alarm about the accelerating pace of receding glaciers in Central Asia and the Caucasus. The ADB assessment, titled Glaciers to Farms Climate Risk and Capacity Assessment, evaluated glaciers and water-usage patterns associated with three river basins – the Naryn and Pyanj in Central Asia, and the Kura in the Caucasus.
